IMTIYAZ MEMON 
CERTIFIED ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING SPECIALIST (CAMS) | 15+ YEARS

+91- 9152531092 | i.memon@mail.com| Mumbai / UAE 
 
 
 
 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
 
CAMS Certified professional with 15+ years of measurable contribution across UAE and India in KYC Operations, 
Quality Analysis, Risk Management, and Team Leadership. Proficient in Process Re-Engineering, Client Profiling, 
and maintaining enduring stakeholder relationships across all levels of the organisation. 
 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
 
 
• Risk Assessment & Controls • Quality Management 
• Compliance & Client Relationship Management • Team Leadership 
• Operations & Delivery Management • Project Management 
• Training Governance • Process Improvement & Automation 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
 
Associate Program Manager May 2021 – June 2026 
Eclerx Services Limited | Navi Mumbai, India 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Spearhead KYC/AML operations for global banking clients covering client onboarding and scheduled periodic 
reviews, consistently meeting internal SLA and quality benchmarks. 
• Transformed outreach governance by restructuring escalation workflows and expedited senior stakeholder sign-offs 
on high-risk KYC files. 
• Established an internal control framework aligning compliance policies, business processes, and regulatory 
standards. 
• Implemented automated Macro Checklists that significantly improved process efficiency and quality scores across 
the team. 
• Conduct regular training sessions on policy updates, regulatory requirements, and best practices — maintaining 
100% completion rates on mandatory trainings. 
• Perform detailed customer risk profiling (Low / Medium / High) and ongoing transaction monitoring to detect 
potential money laundering activity. 
• Serve as primary point of contact for internal/external audits and regulatory investigations; work with Global QA 
team to maintain consistency with the Global QA framework. 
• Provide weekly key performance updates to Top Management and Client Officials, covering operational metrics 
across efficiency, volume, and quality. 

Country Site Manager Oct 2019 – Apr 2021 
Citicorp Services India Ltd (Client of Wipro Limited) | Pune, India 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Directed a team of 42 onsite staff in delivering KYC/AML services for global investment banking clients across 
new onboarding, renewals, and remediation projects. 
• Governed remediation projects and presented progress reports to Senior Management and successfully closed 
critical projects within agreed timelines. 
• Led compliance risk assessment efforts measuring inherent and residual risk for U.S. Operations' business 
activities. 
• Standardized and optimized Pulse Report dashboard to measure, track, and improve team performance KPIs. 
• Globally responsible for publishing Monthly Business Review (MBR) reports presented by Management to Citi 
Global Head. 
• Improved employee retention by strategically aligning team assignments to individual skill sets.

Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE

• Hosted AML call report meetings with Relationship Managers, Business Heads, Compliance, and High-Risk Client 
stakeholders locally and globally. 
• Led the unit through Internal Audit, external regulatory reviews, and Compliance testing, consistently achieving 
management expectations. 
• Published monthly and quarterly reports for Senior Management on progress across people, process, clients, 
controls, and technology. 
• Implemented AML Framework policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory standards and internal 
governance requirements. 
Manager – Middle East KYC Operations Jan 2014 – Sep 2015 
Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE

• Conducted UAT and infrastructure readiness for Information Services Group and Citi KYC system releases.

Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE

• Collaborated with Relationship Management on client renewals and changes in local/global requirements.

deficiencies.

Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE

Jordan, and Pakistan. 
• Implemented AML/KYC policies and procedures as per local and global requirements; performed KYC review and 
approval. 
• Researched companies using KYC/AML tools including World Check, Zawya, Dun & Bradstreet, and regulatory 
websites.
